title: The Grid — drones, constructs, density tables
authority: Design text only. Does not rewrite native-bible catalogs, volume density weights, the enc_census clock, the enc_junction_null clock, Canon lore, countries.json, factions, or prior slices S01–S10.

canon_pins.law_text: Damage hides until you let it exist. The hide is presentation. The hit still resolves in HitResolver. A finished sum fails the Refusal of Numbers even if the bar breaks.
canon_pins.density_law: Do not be counted. Dogs are not drones. No rifles in ambient hands.
canon_pins.humanoid_body: CX male or CX female. Concordia face. Wardrobe on CX_Head, CX_Chest, CX_Shoulder_L, CX_Shoulder_R, CX_Hip, CX_Grip_R, CX_Back. People in this slice are npc_role_grid_labor and npc_role_grid_officer.
canon_pins.flower_law: Hub only. Canon.HubLawRadius is 42 m. It does not govern the Grid. Steel carried inside that disk and outside the Arena dies as flowers.

pinewood_crossing.rule: Outside every Cyber circle. Every id in this slice has cap 0 on that verge.

forbidden_stand_ins: CX body as a dog or a bird
hyb_censusconstruct as a substitute sentinel or construct

canon_pins.alias_resolution: On Cyber, drone resolves to mon_grid_drone at the cap in this file. sentinel resolves to mon_grid_sentinel. construct resolves to mon_grid_construct. drone does not resolve to hyb_billdrone, mon_boss_census, or the Canon seed rogue_drone_swarm. Crime's drone alias stays hyb_billdrone inside S09's enc_rotor_saddle.

geography.method: Floors are a placed country anchor, an 8 m deck derived from that anchor along the country's own step, or a gap between two CountryCenter circles. A faction capital is a rim. A kit named set with no Canon point is not a floor. District anchors in countries.json are capital + (8, -6), length 10 m. The sky-bridge is 8 m, so it cannot be the capital-to-district step. It continues outward from the district.

overlaps_left_empty.note: nevex_tower_central (-45.43, -39.38) sits in both circles. Cap 0.
under_district (14.3, -38.39) sits in both circles. Cap 0. Blackout's disputed_border lists only zero_collective. The geometry is what empties the district.
Circles overlap. The clinic point does not. The clinic stays a floor. The overlap band stays empty.

sky_deck.what: The census sky deck. Eyes go up because a slate treats the deck as not-ground. One door at the near snap. No second door at the far snap.
sky_deck.kit_rule: arch_kit_cyber_grid named set sky_bridge has no Canon point. The anchor plus the 8 m plan is the floor. hall_bridge dresses it when the set is placed. Drones hover on the plan either way. Sparrows wait for a junction box or a cable tray.

clinic_hinge.what: The only placed Street Docs coordinate that sits in that circle alone. A construct with a ground-off serial is the no-records rule in a body. The capital stays empty.
clinic_hinge.kit_rule: A hinge-room module is dressing on this point, not a second floor.

uncounted_gap.what: Open ground between the AI Rights circle and the Cordon Guild circle. No country radius covers the midpoint. Dogs the Census misses stand here. The nullhound's one skipped tick stands here.
uncounted_gap.kit_rule: Named set uncounted_alley has no Canon point. The gap is legal ground. Stray points stay on the open segment, off both rims.

triangle_when_window_up.lead: The lens whose tick is fastest.
triangle_when_window_up.note: An 8 by 4 deck locked by three discs is the window. Ambient spacing is what keeps the deck walkable the rest of the night.

mini_bosses.name: The Disc Triangle
mini_bosses.status: new window, existing drone, no new mesh
mini_bosses.catalog_note: hostile is already true. Ambient 2 are removed for the window so the peak stays 3.

telegraph.board: The near-snap slate shows three digits and no total.
telegraph.scout: Three thick discs, one triangle, the fastest tick on the lead lens. Readable at 100 m as discs, not birds.
telegraph.sound: Three counting ticks. One of them pulls ahead.

phases.name: Paint
phases.tell: Three digits on the acrylic. No sum yet.
phases.player_response: Read them. Do not add them up out loud on a slate.

phases.name: Sum
phases.player_response: Stay off the finished number. A completed sum makes you terrain.

phases.name: Lead lens
phases.tell: The fast lens commits hide-number. Magenta is not on these discs. Cyan is the windup.
phases.player_response: skill_steel_pulse on that lens. Sparrows, techs, and the officer are not targets. The other two discs scatter. They do not replicate.

loot_conditions.items: None. lens_shard and acrylic are card strings, not item ids.

mini_bosses.name: The Open Hinge
mini_bosses.status: new window, existing construct, no new mesh

schedule.label: Clinic morning, every third day offset

mini_bosses.catalog_note: hostile is false on the monster row. This window sets aggro. The file is not edited.

telegraph.board: The clinic door has a blank where the serial plate was. Fresh grind marks.
telegraph.scout: Asymmetric hood, tool arm lifted toward its own chest, hand arm loose. Not a sentinel. No bar visor.

phases.name: Aim
phases.tell: The tool points at the ground-off serial.
phases.player_response: Do not fit a digit into the blank.

phases.name: Spark
phases.tell: Windup is the grind. The spark is the commit.
phases.player_response: Knock the toolhead if you must. skill_presence_refuse_count helps if you already have it. The quest does not require the skill.

phases.name: Still blank
phases.tell: The tool lowers. The frame walks.
phases.player_response: Leave it walking and blank. A corpse fails the clinic quest. A stamped serial fails the refusal.

loot_conditions.items: None. serial_blank and toolhead are card strings, not item ids.

mini_bosses.name: The Skipped Tick
mini_bosses.status: new window, existing hybrid, no new mesh

schedule.label: Gap dawn, every third day, after the Census hour

mini_bosses.catalog_note: hostile is false on the hybrid row. This window sets aggro. The file is not edited.

telegraph.board: No slate owns this ground. A tick is audible with nowhere to land.
telegraph.scout: Dog chevron, two rectangles on the ribs, larger than the one-eared strays standing 4 m off the midpoint.
telegraph.sound: A counting tick that skips one beat.

phases.name: File
phases.tell: The tick tries to finish a number for the plated dog.
phases.player_response: Do not complete it. The strays are not part of the file.

phases.name: Cloak
phases.tell: Plates slide shut. Silhouette stays. One dodge window.
phases.player_response: The skip is the tell. Jamming the hinge ends the cloak and is a hit, not a capture. Do not chip the one-eared stray because the plates looked like a diagram.

phases.name: Plates open
phases.tell: It is a dog with metal on the ribs again.
phases.player_response: Leave it in the gap. Do not haul it to the deck and do not skin it into faun_grid_stray.

loot_conditions.items: None. null_plate is a card string, not an item id.

side_quests.title: Deck — The Sum Stays Dark
side_quests.backstory_public: A cable tech on the Zero deck has watched a finished sum become a floor. The same acrylic, the next night, pings a person who walks it because the number was allowed to exist. They want the lead lens broken while the other two digits are still paint.
withheld: Kael's private reason for the first sparing

objectives.text: Take the watch from the hail tech one module along the deck. They stay at that mark.
Stand on the deck during enc_disc_triangle, or on the paint if the window has closed and the digits are still there.
See three digits and no total. If the window is up, break the lead lens. Bring the unfinished sum back. Leave the sparrows.

side_quests.fail: Completing the sum, or killing a sparrow or a witness to clear the deck.
side_quests.item_note: item_count_slate is not granted. q_cyber_packet_tea already hands one out.
side_quests.skill_note: skill_steel_pulse is not granted. q_cyber_practice_rail already can.
side_quests.faction_alias_note: The labor role's faction_id is zero_collective. This quest writes blackout_resistance once, because the public act is an unfinished count. It does not also write zero_collective, and it does not open a book named uncounted.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the one laborer at 4 m along the deck.

side_quests.title: Clinic — The Serial Stays Ground
side_quests.backstory_public: Street Docs keep no file Nevex can subpoena. The construct at the clinic door tries, on its mornings, to engrave itself back into the count that ground its serial off. The tech on that cable wants a witness who will not help it succeed.
withheld: Which corp funded the seventeen children

objectives.text: Accept from the laborer at the clinic point. They are not a named doc and not a clone of Marit.
Be at the clinic during enc_hinge_blank.
See the frame walk away with the serial still blank. Tell the laborer. Do not stamp a digit.

side_quests.fail: A stamped serial, or a dead construct at phase 3.
side_quests.skill_note: skill_presence_refuse_count is not granted. q_cyber_missing_number and q_cyber_lavren_door already can.
side_quests.faction_alias_note: The giver's role row says zero_collective. The act is the clinic's no-records rule. Write cyber_street_docs once. The country file's disputed_border string cyber_polysteel_society is not a country id. Do not open that book.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the one laborer spent at the clinic.

side_quests.title: Gap — The Tick Skips
side_quests.backstory_public: An officer with the bar down and the coat on was put on the open meters because a miss there is not yet a defect in somebody's circle. They can tell the plated dog from the one-eared dog. They want the skip seen, and the scar left as skin.

objectives.text: Accept from the officer in the gap. That body is not Holt and not the officer on the deck.
Stand at the midpoint during enc_cloak_skip. The strays are 4 m off that point.
See the tick skip and the silhouette stay. Tell the officer. Do not fit a port to the stray. Do not write a total.

side_quests.fail: Porting the stray, or killing either dog to simplify the report.
side_quests.item_note: No slate. q_cyber_hand_list and q_cyber_packet_tea already move slates.
side_quests.faction_alias_note: The officer role's faction_id is census_authority. That string is not a country. Write blackout_resistance once. Do not open census_authority or uncounted.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the one officer spent in the gap.
